title: Cat ores
description: it changes the texture of the ores to cat heads
body:
Bring a cat ores
This resource pack replaces every vanilla ore with a cat‑themed variant perfect for players who want their world to feel more cozy, silly, or just downright adorable.
 Features
 Cat‑themed textures for all overworld and Nether ores
 Designed to stay faithful to Minecraft’s style while adding personality
Works in both survival and creative worlds
Lightweight and compatible with most other packs            
Whether you’re mining diamonds or smelting iron, every ore block now shows you with a cute cat face. Perfect for cat lovers, builders, and anyone who wants a more cat world ig.
